comment: Datum-frame predicates written by QA from INTAKE_CARD §3/§4 and MODELING_PLAN §6, before any deviation number was seen. Cups at x=±19.49 (datum audit), flange top z=0. interface_max is null under baseline-skill, so functional_interface zones are REPORTED, not gated (INTAKE_CARD §4 'reported'). Scan-point normals are vertex normals (outward, checked on the flange top: 100% nz>0); CAD normals are tessellation face normals.

zones.name: Z1 flange top + skirt outline
zones.note: INTAKE §4 Z1 (seat/locate). Flange top z±0.3 facing up, plus outward-facing skirt faces z -3.3..-0.3 (outward = normal points away from the part centre; excludes the invented pocket/skirt inner faces)

zones.name: Z2 barb nipples A+B
zones.note: INTAKE §4 Z2 (hose connections): shank, flare, lip, tip, z>=14.5 within 4.5 mm of each cup axis in y. CAD side also contains the invented through-bore wall (see I3)

zones.name: Z3 ear lugs + holes
zones.note: INTAKE §4 Z3 (screw/peg fixing): |x| 34.5..43, z 11..15.5. Lug underside only partly seen (INTAKE §3)

zones.name: Z4 cup outer walls
zones.note: INTAKE §4 Z4 (valve housing): side walls |x| 7..32, |y|>=1.5 (off the webs), z 0.3..11.8, near-vertical normals. CAD side also contains cavity walls behind (invented)

zones.name: I1 underside + skirt inner (unscanned)
zones.note: INTAKE §3 row 1 (not scanned at all) + MODELING_PLAN §6 (under-plate pocket, wall_t 1.2 assumed)

zones.name: I2 downward-facing interior (cavity ceilings, inner shoulders)
zones.note: INTAKE §3 row 2 (cup/boss interiors not scanned) + MODELING_PLAN §6 (cavities = skin offset by wall_t). Below z 19 inside |x|<32 no outer face points down

zones.name: I3 barb bores
zones.note: INTAKE §3 row 3 (opening only) + MODELING_PLAN §6 (depth assumed through). Box |dx|,|y| <= 1.35 about each cup axis (corner r 1.91 < barb tip skin)

zones.name: I4 boss hole
zones.note: INTAKE §3 row 4 (opening + ~1 mm wall) + MODELING_PLAN §6 (depth assumed through)
